<section id="logo" class="mb-14 card anchor">
  <h2 class="big-shoulders text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold mb-6 accent-underline">
    Logo System & Visual Identity
  </h2>

  <!-- System overview (short + clear) -->
  <div class="mb-6">
    <h3 class="text-2xl font-semibold mb-3">System Overview</h3>
    <p class="mb-4">
      The <span class="coral">coral brow</span> and <span class="coral">coral hyphen</span> are constants—never recolored.  
      Each color family (white or black) has a <strong>default</strong> logo with a coral symbol, and a
      <strong>mono alt</strong> where only the symbol switches to match the type color (brow stays coral).
    </p>
  </div>

  <!-- 4 variants (previews on correct backgrounds) -->
  <div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:gap-6 mb-8">
    <!-- WHITE — DEFAULT -->
    <div class="text-center">
      <div class="eyebrow mb-2">White — Default (coral symbol)</div>
      <div class="usage-preview usage-bg-dark">
        <img src="/images/logo-lockup_white_default.svg"
             alt="Luis Gilberto logo — white default with coral symbol on dark"
             width="600" height="400" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
      </div>
      <p class="text-sm muted mt-2">Use on dark backgrounds.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- WHITE — ALT -->
    <div class="text-center">
      <div class="eyebrow mb-2">White — Alt (mono symbol)</div>
      <div class="usage-preview usage-bg-dark">
        <img src="/images/logo-lockup_white_alt.svg"
             alt="Luis Gilberto logo — white alt with monochrome symbol on dark"
             width="600" height="400" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
      </div>
      <p class="text-sm muted mt-2">Use on dark when surrounding art already has strong coral.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- BLACK — DEFAULT -->
    <div class="text-center">
      <div class="eyebrow mb-2">Black — Default (coral symbol)</div>
      <div class="usage-preview usage-bg-light">
        <img src="/images/logo-lockup_black_default.svg"
             alt="Luis Gilberto logo — black default with coral symbol on light"
             width="600" height="400" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
      </div>
      <p class="text-sm muted mt-2">Use on white/light backgrounds.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- BLACK — ALT -->
    <div class="text-center">
      <div class="eyebrow mb-2">Black — Alt (mono symbol)</div>
      <div class="usage-preview usage-bg-light">
        <img src="/images/logo-lockup_black_alt.svg"
             alt="Luis Gilberto logo — black alt with monochrome symbol on light"
             width="600" height="400" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
      </div>
      <p class="text-sm muted mt-2">Use on light when coral in the layout would compete.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="divider"></div>

  <!-- Rules (no filenames shown) -->
  <div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
    <div class="card-tight">
      <h4 class="font-semibold coral mb-2">Do</h4>
      <ul class="text-sm space-y-1">
        <li>Use <strong>White Default</strong> on dark, <strong>Black Default</strong> on light.</li>
        <li>Use the <strong>mono alt</strong> only to avoid coral overload in the surrounding art.</li>
        <li>Keep coral brow & hyphen exactly <code>#F96F6E</code>.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="card-tight">
      <h4 class="font-semibold coral mb-2">Don't</h4>
      <ul class="text-sm space-y-1">
        <li>Don’t recolor the brow or hyphen.</li>
        <li>Don’t add outlines, shadows, or gradients.</li>
        <li>Don’t stretch, skew, or place on busy/low-contrast backgrounds.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="card-tight">
      <h4 class="font-semibold coral mb-2">Specs</h4>
      <ul class="text-sm space-y-1">
        <li><strong>Min height:</strong> 48px for hero/headers; 40px for compact placements.</li>
        <li><strong>Clearspace:</strong> ≥ 0.5× the coral brow height around the lockup.</li>
        <li><strong>Formats:</strong> SVG primary (sRGB). Raster only when required.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
